{{Quote|I fought in the Foundry Uprising. My son taught me the nine edicts of Teräs Käsi. I'm not afraid to hurt you...|The soldier shortly before being killed by Teneb Kel|<ref name="BotE1" />}}
This '''male Human''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and fought in the [[Foundry Uprising]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. He was killed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Begeren]] in [[3678 BBY]] by [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]] during the [[Invasion of Begeren]].<ref name="BotE1" />

He claimed to know the nine edicts of the [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] from his son.
